test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Inclusive of private packs it is difficult to ________ more than an overall total of 60 drag and/or bloodhound packs.
solution: The correct answer is: **Envisage** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Envisage**" means to imagine or visualize something in the future. (भविष्य में किसी चीज़ की कल्पना करना) • **Example**: *She couldn't envisage a better future for herself.* • The sentence is saying that it's difficult to imagine more than 60 packs in total, including private ones. • The word is used correctly in the sentence and fits the context. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. **Complete sentence**: *Inclusive of private packs it is difficult to envisage __more than an overall total of 60 drag and/or bloodhound packs.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Haemorrhage **means to bleed heavily. (भारी रक्तस्राव होना) • **Package **means to wrap or bundle something up. (किसी चीज़ को लपेटना या बंडल करना) • **Discourage **means to try to prevent or dissuade someone from doing something. (किसी को कुछ करने से रोकने या हतोत्साहित करने का प्रयास करना) 1b6:T708, The correct answer is: "**foods that is fatty**,".
